description.text: A wall of churning black smoke fills the air above a burning battlefield, then tears open as a huge black dragon bursts through with its wings beating hard. The beast skims barely above shattered siege engines, burning grass and broken spears, its scaled flank catching the firelight. A knight in battered, soot-blackened plate armour is braced low in a saddle between the dragon's shoulder spines, cloak whipping, ash streaming from the armour plates. The knight half-rises against the wind, turns a visored helm toward the unseen line below and shouts a short command that is torn away by the rush of air, one gauntlet locked on the reins. Firelight slides over the dented breastplate while the ground blurs beneath the dragon and embers stream past in the dragon's wake.
Deep wingbeats thud against the air beneath a roar of flames and distant battle clamour.
Black smoke boils, then tears open around the dragon and knight.
The knight braces low in the saddle and shouts a short command into the wind while the dragon skims over the burning ground.
Wind rushes past armour and embers hiss through the air.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at fast speed.

The shot cuts to a closer view of the knight in the saddle as the dragon's neck snakes forward through drifting embers. The knight hauls on the leather reins with one gauntlet, then raises a notched broadsword overhead; the blade trembles in the wind and firelight flickers across the dented breastplate. His visored helm stays turned toward the unseen line below, and his posture settles into a hard, braced readiness after the command has gone. Beside him the dragon's jaws part, teeth glinting, while smoke curls between the shoulder spines and the saddle creaks under the strain. The knight holds the sword high, his cloak snapping behind him, as ash and sparks streak past the pair.
The knight hauls on the reins with one gauntlet and raises the notched broadsword overhead.
Leather reins creak and embers hiss past the saddle.
The knight settles into a braced readiness, visor turned toward the unseen line below.
The dragon's jaws part with a low scrape of scales beside him.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The black dragon banks hard, one wingtip trailing sparks, and climbs away over a jagged line of burning trenches and collapsed banners. The knight drops back into the saddle and holds the notched sword out to the side, his cloak and the dragon's spines streaming in the wake. Below them the full breadth of the burning battlefield opens out: smoke columns bend across ruined engines, scattered fires pulse along the trench lines, and the last of the battle clamour thins beneath the wingbeats. The dragon's dark shape rises against the smoke, embers sliding off its scales, while the knight keeps his visor forward and the sword steady as the pair climb clear of the fire line.
The black dragon banks hard, one wingtip trailing sparks, and climbs away over the burning trenches.
A low brass-and-percussion score rises under a wash of wingbeats and firestorm roar.
The knight drops back into the saddle and holds the broadsword out to the side as the battlefield opens out below.
Wind thins as the dragon climbs and the battle clamour fades beneath the wingbeats.
The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed.
